entries.partTitle: Serverless API Ingress: REST vs HTTP vs WebSocket Gateway Architectures

left.title: Unprotected Ingress
items: Exposes backend compute directly to public web.
Lacks unified authentication and WAF filtering.
High latency without global edge caching.

right.title: API Gateway Tier
items: Single secure front door for all microservices.
HTTP APIs reduce latency by sixty percent.
WebSockets establish full-duplex TCP sockets.

entries.partTitle: Ingress Governance: Token Bucket Throttling, Usage Plans & Lambda Authorizers

left.title: Unthrottled APIs
items: Runaway client scripts saturate database pools.
Lacks commercial usage plan enforcement.
Authorizer overhead on repetitive client requests.

right.title: Token Bucket Guard
items: Token bucket algorithm limits rate and burst.
Rejects excess calls at the edge with HTTP four twenty nine.
Authorizer result caching eliminates cold starts.

entries.partTitle: Managed GraphQL: AWS AppSync Schema Directives, Pipeline & JS Resolvers

left.title: REST Over-Fetching
items: Multiple HTTP roundtrips to render single screen.
Over-fetching wastes mobile bandwidth and battery.
Under-fetching causes sequential API request waterfalls.

right.title: AppSync GraphQL
items: Single query retrieves exactly required fields.
JavaScript resolvers aggregate multi-source data.
Schema directives enforce field-level security.

entries.partTitle: Real-Time Ingress: API Gateway WebSockets & Managed AppSync Subscriptions

left.title: HTTP Polling
items: Clients repeatedly query servers for new state.
Drains mobile battery and floods web servers.
Delayed notification of critical business events.

right.title: WebSocket Push
items: Persistent full-duplex TCP socket connection.
Pushes live events to clients in milliseconds.
Connection registry tracks active client sockets.

entries.partTitle: Enterprise Ingress Synthesis: Unified REST, GraphQL & WebSocket Edge Tier

left.title: Fragmented Ingress
items: Isolated gateways managed with inconsistent security.
Lacks centralized tracing across protocols.
No unified cryptographic verification token.

right.title: Hybrid Edge Ingress
items: Synthesizes REST, GraphQL, and WebSocket gateways.
WAF, JWT authorizers, and X-Ray tracing unified.
Emits cryptographic confirmation token upon test.
